inventory.answer: Second Battle of Cancha Rayada took place on March 16, 1818

decision.explanation: The question asks when the Battle of Cancha Rayada took place. The original sources distinguish two separate battles: the First Battle of Cancha Rayada (D1S1) occurred on 29 March, 1814, and the Second Battle of Cancha Rayada (D2S1) occurred on 16 March, 1818. Both are valid referents under the broader name 'Battle of Cancha Rayada.' There is no evidence of conflicting claims within the same referent, so both dates are retained as distinct valid answers.
